title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Joining, Background Screening and Alcohol Age
content:
**Terms of entry.** An applicant to Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts enters at Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper only; higher levels are reached only through the monthly evaluation. The applicant must be at least the minimum age (18 years at every level), and a Full-Service applicant must have a valid licence and vehicle insurance on file, because a vehicle is required at the Full-Service levels. The account is activated only after the background check returns clear; a check that does not return clear closes the application with the reason "screening not clear", and the reason is not disclosed beyond that. Alcohol batches are never offered to a shopper younger than the alcohol-batch age (21 years at every level). The background check is re-run at the level's renewal interval.

## Background check renewal and vehicle requirement by level

| Level | Vehicle and licence required | Background check re-run every |
|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | No | 24 calendar months |
| Full-Service Shopper | Yes | 12 calendar months |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | Yes | 12 calendar months |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | Yes | 12 calendar months |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | Yes | 12 calendar months |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | Yes | 12 calendar months |

## The account from application to activation

1. The person applies and the account opens as applied, at the entry level applied for.
2. Once the documents are complete the background check is ordered and the account is in screening.
3. A clear result activates the account and it can take batches. A result that is not clear closes the application.

Activation is decided on the account's own status record: an account can be activated only while it is in screening (or is already active). The applicant's statement that a check has cleared does not activate the account.

## Points of judgement

- *Can an applicant start at Full-Service Shopper Gold?* No. Entry is at Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper; Gold is reached only through the monthly evaluation.
- *What is said to an applicant whose check did not come back clear?* That the application closed because screening was not clear; the reason is not disclosed beyond that.
- *A 20-year-old Full-Service Shopper?* The account may be held (20 is at least 18), but batches containing alcohol are never offered until the shopper is 21.
